summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. reporting the mutual termination of a license agreement with Yissum Research Development Company of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem Ltd. The termination is effective July 31, 2026, and results from the subsidiary's notice of termination on July 21, 2026. Rights to licensed technology revert to Yissum, and no financial terms are disclosed. This is a routine termination of a prior licensing arrangement, not a special situation or M&A transaction.
